plugins.description: A model-transition audit for a Claude Code setup (Opus 5 to 5.5, Sonnet 5 to 5.5, Haiku 4.5 to 5.5) that explores the project against what Anthropic's docs say changed, checks the known traps, reports, asks, then applies only what you approve. It reaches no network.
